notes: Numeric baselines for the harness-kit repo. This file pins NUMBERS ONLY. A standing operator obligation goes in .harness/operator-obligations.md, never here. Every count below is TRANSCRIBED from that driver's own PASS line on a real run, never derived arithmetically.

_constraints.test_init_bash_no_python3_assertions: Transcribed from a python3-PRESENT run at v0.50.0 (379; 373 + two playbook-distribution assertions per project type). The AI-native block is gated on python3, so a host without it reads lower; re-transcribe from your own run rather than adjusting this one.
_constraints.test_archive_task_bash_assertions: AC-15's corpus rows are FLOORS and do NOT rise with the archive. The reason lives in test-archive-task.sh's own AC-15 block, which is the only reader; raising a floor to match a grown corpus re-opens the trap one commit later.
_constraints.windows-removal: v0.49.0 removed Windows support. Every *_ps_assertions key is gone with the .ps1 driver it pinned, and the 28 operator obligations those keys' notes enumerated were retired with them — see .harness/operator-obligations.md. Do not re-add a PowerShell key; there is no PowerShell driver to transcribe one from.
_constraints.test_verify_i6_bash_assertions: 50 after v0.49.0 retired the 2x2 cross-shell lockstep rows — there is one list now, so the eight rows that compared two of them measured nothing and were removed, not disabled.
_constraints.test_harness_upgrade_bash_assertions: 93 after v0.50.0 added the S2b playbook-refresh rows to fixture A and its re-run. Two of the four assert on CONTENT (eight files on disk, the developer playbook carrying its schema) rather than on the emitted REFRESH line: a stage that logs a copy it never made would pass a log-only check and leave every agent on its degradation clause.
